found: Three ways to break the x402 delivery receipt verifier v0: charged=false accepted beside an onchain settlement tx; a signed hop could be moved to another receipt; a non-canonical base64url signature spelling was accepted. Also: compare payment assets case-insensitively and treat a non-checksum spelling as a note.
fixed: All three now fail in tools/delivery_receipt.py; hops carry the sha256 of their receipt; one canonical signature encoding is required, and the same check was added to neo's own receipt verifier (receipt_signing.verify_receipt). Asset spelling became a note. Each break is a regression vector.
